_about: 撒豆成兵 · 守山门 (the DEFENCE crowd game, test-only beside 撒豆成兵; Hanli 10-21: 「一共3列, 要么打野猪, 要么打两边的+攻击的卡」). One row a level. The road runs from the wall (z 0) to the far end (z 100) in three columns (core.js COLS: L · M · R). The squad (`squad` 豆兵 at the start) fires on its own up the column it stands in: `shot.rate` + `perSoldier` a 豆兵 thrown a second (to `max`), at `shot.speed` z/s, the whole attack `dps` a 豆兵 a second × the tier's `power` (`tiers`: 豆兵 → 纸甲兵 → 铜人). `belt`: the side columns' things riding down at `speed` z/s, laid by `lines` (`col`, `from` + k·`every` to `until`): `cards` cycled one a row — a card's `n` (red below 0) goes up `step` a hit and pays at its `cap`, or at the line if the squad stands in its column — and `wall`s with `hp` that shield what is behind (`gives: tier` lifts the squad a tier). `waves`: the 兽潮 down the middle, each at `t` s, [[beast, n]…] (the last kind the front rank), at `speed` z/s; at the wall `breach` beasts a second break on it. `boss`: walks down from `stand` at `speed`; its `charge` every `every` s down the squad's column, shown `warn` s ahead, knocks `kill` of the squad aside unless it moved off; at the wall it crushes `crush` a second. `wall`: the 山门's hp; `stars`: [★★★, ★★] by the share of it left, ★★★ inside `par` s. `press`: the bots' turn to the middle. `hui`: the 回 the level belongs to — it sends only beasts met by then.

beasts._about: power: how many 豆兵 one beast takes. size: its drawn height (px) at the wall; it shrinks up the road. frames: 守墙关's painted frames, shared (scripts/games/shouqiang/art/<id>-<frame>.webp); `art: "sadou"` = 撒豆成兵's own (the 蠪侄). A boss has a `name` (the HP bar) and `face`. `fly`: it bobs. The beasts a level may send are the book's by its `hui` (creatures.json `hui` ≤ the level's; tests/game-sadoushou.test.mjs).

jieyin._about: 结印 at the camera (Hanli 10-21: 「把结印放到现有的塔防类游戏中」; the dock is games/jieyin/helper.js, only where a camera is). Offered `when` (boss · waves · always; boss by default — 「别让用户太累」), a move strikes a BEAST — the 大妖 when it is out, else the nearest wave down the hand's column (or the squad's), else the nearest anywhere; never a card or a wall (「接了印后, 火弹没有打怪, 打了一个近处的卡」) — for `secs` of the squad's attack at once (× `bossMul` on the 大妖), then the hand rests `cool` s. Never needed to win (「用户结印失败, 或者不愿意使用摄像头, 塔防游戏也能正常完成」); it makes the kill faster, so ★★★ inside `par` comes easier (「结印可以帮助更快杀敌, 更容易取得3星成就」). The move rows are 守墙关's shape (`seals` + `motion: jab` a 小招; `jieyin` a 大招 from jieyin.json; `from` the save's marks first).

lead.zh: 天擦黑，山道上黑压压一片——野猪下山了，后头还跟着个大的。
lead.en: At dusk the mountain road goes dark with them — the boars are coming down, and something big behind.

lead.zh: 小满跳上山门：豆兵自己会打，你只管左右挪——打两边的卡壮大队伍，打中间的野猪。
lead.en: Xiaoman jumps onto the gate. The bean soldiers fire on their own — you only move: hit the side cards to grow the squad, hit the boars in the middle.

moments._about: 银月's lines at the level's moments (the defaults; the host may send her prefetched ones — doc/game-kit.md § 台词预取). One is picked per moment.

start.zh: 豆兵自己会打，你只管左右挪！两边的卡越打越大，中间的兽要打死。
start.en: The soldiers fire on their own — just move! Side cards grow as you hit them; the beasts in the middle must die.

card.zh: 那张卡打大了，站过去接住！
card.en: That card's grown — stand under it to take it!

red.zh: 红卡别接，打到正的再说。
red.en: Don't take a red card — shoot it positive first.

wall.zh: 石墙后面有好东西，打碎它！
wall.en: Something good behind that stone wall — break it!

tier.en: New armour — the soldiers hit harder!

low.en: The gate won't hold much longer!

boss.en: The great beast is out! Everyone, at it!

charge.zh: 它要冲你这一列了，换一列！
charge.en: It's charging your column — move to another!

won.en: We held! Well done, bean soldiers.

lost.zh: 山门破了……差一点，再来一把豆子。
lost.en: The gate broke… so close. Another handful of beans.

title.en: The Gate · Zheng in the Pines

lead.zh: 松林里有狰在吼，野猪被它赶着往山门涌。
lead.en: A zheng roars in the pines, driving the boars down at the gate.

lead.zh: 红的是坏卡，别让它落到队伍里——多打几下，它也能翻成好的。
lead.en: The red cards are bad — don't let one reach your squad. Shoot it enough and it turns good.

lead.en: The qiuyu broke the herb-garden fence; the tide is coming down.

lead.zh: 石墙打碎了，豆兵就披上纸甲——更能打。
lead.en: Break a stone wall and the bean soldiers put on paper armour — they hit harder.

title.en: The Gate · Qique on Black Pine

lead.zh: 黑松岭上鬿雀成群，飞得比走兽快。
lead.en: Over Black Pine Ridge the qique flock — they fly faster than anything that walks.

lead.zh: 犰狳在底下跟着，合窳压阵。
lead.en: The qiuyu follow below, and the Heyu brings up the rear.
